name: Capital benefit of CHF 250,000, Bellinzona: Ticino's 2% floor
workings: A capital benefit of 250,000.00 alone in the year (a payout from ch.pillar3a).
Federal: 1/5 of the tariff (at most 11.5% of the amount): 3,900.6880.
Ticino: the annuity it buys (50.77 per 1,000, table male) rounded down to 100: 12,600; the tariff's average rate on it 0.2003%, kept between 2% and 3%: 2.0000%; simple tax 5,000.0000.
A secondary comparison gives CHF 13,551 for Bellinzona, which this reproduces.
